system.name: DDVI (Denoising Diffusion Variational Inference)
system.one_liner: Black-box variational inference that uses a diffusion model as a flexible approximate posterior over the latents of a VAE, trained with a regularized ELBO.

content.variant_note: a diffusion chain y_T ... y_0 unrolled between a VAE encoder and decoder, with a strip of scatter plots showing the latent distribution refined state by state
content.argues: A diffusion chain placed between the encoder and decoder of a VAE maps a simple distribution into a complex distribution over the latents, giving an expressive variational posterior.
content.subject: VAE row (x, encoder, diffusion chain y_T to y_0, decoder, reconstruction) with prior boxes above and a scatter-plot strip below

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw a diffusion chain as a row of circles between encoder and decoder trapezoids, solid arrows for the reverse step and dashed for the forward step, and put a strip of scatter plots under it so the reader sees a distribution turn from blob to spiral state by state.
lessons.suits: Latent-variable or diffusion methods where an iterative refinement chain sits inside a larger model and its effect can be shown on 2-D toy data.

summary: DDVI is a black-box variational inference method that uses a diffusion model as a flexible approximate posterior over the latents of a VAE. The figure draws the VAE as one row: an input picture x enters a pale yellow trapezoid encoder q_φ, passes a chain of grey circles y_T to y_0, and a decoder p_θ gives the reconstruction x̂. Solid black arrows are the reverse step q_φ(y_t-1|y_t, x), dashed black arrows the forward step r(y_t|y_t-1, x); long red arcs above and below give the end-to-end forward and reverse distributions. Two light-blue boxes mark a simple prior and flexible priors at the chain ends. Five scatter plots underneath show a noisy cloud sharpening into a coloured spiral.
summary_zh: DDVI 用扩散模型充当 VAE 隐变量的灵活变分后验。图把 VAE 画成一行：输入图像经编码器、一串 y_T 到 y_0 的灰色圆圈（实线为逆向、虚线为前向）和解码器得到重建；上方有两个先验框，下方五张散点图展示噪声团逐步变成彩色螺旋。
notes: No paragraph of the paper mentions this figure, so the roles rest on the caption, the abstract and the drawing. The blue dashed arrows to the prior boxes and the exact alignment of the five scatter plots with the chain states are inferred, not stated. The picture under x and x̂ looks AI-generated.
